name: pr-reviewer
description: Convenience scripts for the backend/ and frontend/ packages. No dependencies live here.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.clean: node -e "for (const d of ['backend/node_modules','backend/dist','frontend/node_modules','frontend/dist']) require('fs').rmSync(d, { recursive: true, force: true })"
